scripts.dev: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sycamore --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node scripts/dev.mjs"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit -p functions && tsc --noEmit -p tests
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sycamore --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sycamore --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node scripts/seed.mjs && playwright test"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sycamore/shared && npm run build -w @sycamore/desktop && npm run build -w @sycamore/functions
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm exec -w @sycamore/desktop -- electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
